title: juicy moroccan fish tagine
description: sweet, springy, kid-friendly moroccan dish featuring vanilla sugar, sashimi-cut, high-protein-friendly.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: chicken or fish broth for extra flavor

instructions: Rinse the salmon fillets under cold water, pat dry with a paper towel, and set aside.
In a large clay or ceramic tagine, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger, ground cumin, and ground cinnamon, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped prunes, 1 cup of water, and 2 tablespoons of vanilla sugar.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the salmon fillets to the tagine, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through.
Season with flaky sea salt to taste, and garnish with chopped parsley.
Optional: for a spicier dish, add 1-2 teaspoons of harissa to the tagine before baking.
